attempts.cause: The constant c_free_over in freight_config is set to 50000 instead of 5000, causing orders above 5000 to be incorrectly charged shipping.
The shipping cost calculation in shipping_cost.cost_for uses ceil(p_weight_kg) which results in a non-zero cost even when the order total is above the free threshold if the weight is non-zero.
The shipping cost calculation in shipping_cost.cost_for does not correctly return 0 when the order total exceeds the free threshold, as the weight calculation is performed regardless of the total.
